# CarsJSON

> A free, public static JSON API providing normalized car brands, models, production years, and brand logos. Zero authentication, zero rate limits, and instant static performance on Cloudflare Pages.

CarsJSON is an open automotive dataset and developer-friendly JSON API. It is designed for automotive web applications, vehicle selectors, analytics, and AI agents.

## Quick Start
All requests are standard HTTP GET requests returning JSON. CORS is enabled globally.

- Base URL: `https://carsjson.pages.dev`
- Brand models endpoint: `https://carsjson.pages.dev/v1/brands/{brand_slug}/models.json`
- All brands endpoint: `https://carsjson.pages.dev/v1/brands.json`
- Full consolidated catalog: `https://carsjson.pages.dev/v1/all.json`

## Endpoints

- [All Brands](https://carsjson.pages.dev/v1/brands.json): Array of all car brands with ID, display name, Cyrillic name, year range, and logo path.
- [Brand Models](https://carsjson.pages.dev/v1/brands/abarth/models.json): Models for a given brand slug in lowercase (e.g., `abarth`, `bmw`, `audi`, `toyota`, `mercedes`).
- [Complete Catalog](https://carsjson.pages.dev/v1/all.json): Single consolidated object `{ "brands": [...], "models": [...] }` containing the full database.
- [Metadata & Versioning](https://carsjson.pages.dev/v1/meta.json): Snapshot version, SHA-256 data hash, entity counts, and generation timestamp.

## Machine-Readable Specifications

- [OpenAPI 3.1 Specification](https://carsjson.pages.dev/openapi.json): Machine-readable schema for AI function calling, Custom GPT Actions, and SDK generation.

## Data Schemas

### Brand Object
```json
{
  "id": "ABARTH",
  "name": "Abarth",
  "cyrillic_name": "Абарт",
  "year_from": 2008,
  "year_to": 2026,
  "logo": "/logos/abarth.webp"
}
```

### Model Object
```json
{
  "id": "500",
  "name": "500",
  "cyrillic_name": "500",
  "year_from": 2008,
  "year_to": 2026,
  "brand_id": "ABARTH",
  "nameplates": ["500", "500e"]
}
```

## Notes for LLMs & AI Agents
- Brand slugs in URL paths must be lowercase matching the brand ID (e.g., `alfa_romeo` for `ALFA_ROMEO`).
- Models are unique within each brand by combining `brand_id` and `id`.
- All logo URLs are relative to the root (e.g., `/logos/{brand_slug}.webp`).
- No API key or authorization header is required.
